diagram.manim_description: Draw one 16:9 figure on a plain white BG with two blocks side by side: the detailed place value computation on the left (about 70 percent of the width) and the compact column form on the right (about 25 percent). LEFT BLOCK. Five columns, left to right, for tens, units, tenths, hundredths and thousandths. Every cell is one expression 'digit × place value' on a single line, the place values being 10, 1, 1/10, 1/100 and 1/1000 (the last three drawn as stacked fractions: 1 over 10, 1 over 100, 1 over 1000). Row 1, drawn in INK: 8 × 10, 4 × 1, 6 × 1/10, 9 × 1/100, 1 × 1/1000. Leave a clear band under row 1 for two FOCUS arrows. Row 2, directly below the band: column 1 shows 7 × 10 in ANSWER, column 2 shows 14 × 1 in ANSWER, column 3 shows 6 × 1/10 in INK, column 4 shows 8 × 1/100 in ANSWER, column 5 shows 11 × 1/1000 in ANSWER. Draw a FOCUS circle around 14 × 1 and a FOCUS circle around 11 × 1/1000. Arrow 1 (FOCUS, no label): from the bottom edge of 8 × 10 in row 1 to the top edge of 14 × 1 in row 2. Arrow 2 (FOCUS, no label): from the bottom edge of 9 × 1/100 in row 1 to the top edge of 11 × 1/1000 in row 2. Row 3, in INK, with a minus sign at the far left of the row: 7 × 10, 7 × 1, 3 × 1/10, 4 × 1/100, 5 × 1/1000. Under row 3 draw one horizontal INK line across the five columns and the sign column. Row 4, in ANSWER, with an equals sign at the far left of the row: 0 × 10, 7 × 1, 3 × 1/10, 4 × 1/100, 6 × 1/1000. RIGHT BLOCK, the compact form, vertically centred against the left block. Line 1 in INK is 84.691 with the 8 and the 9 each crossed by one thin ANSWER diagonal stroke; a small ANSWER 7 stands above the crossed 8, a small ANSWER 8 stands above the crossed 9, a small ANSWER 1 stands at the top left of the 4 and a small ANSWER 1 stands at the top left of the last digit 1. Line 2 in INK is a minus sign followed by 77.345, digits aligned under line 1 point under point. Under line 2 draw one horizontal INK line across the full width. Line 3 in ANSWER is an equals sign followed by 7.346, the 7 under the units digits, the point under the points. No column titles, no words, no labels on the arrows, no captions anywhere.
